result.summary: Detected 2 minor to major visual and accessibility issues regarding text contrast and element truncation.

issues.description: White text in the promotional banner has low contrast against the pale green background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the text color or adjust background saturation to meet contrast standards.

issues.description: The third restaurant title in the horizontal list is abruptly clipped at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis or adjust card spacing.
